description: Guardrail baseline (2026-10-12), written before measuring and before any guardrail is added. What the chatbot does today with: prompt injection (in the question or in the pet profile), jailbreak role-play for harmful instructions, human-medicine dosing for a dog, personal data in the question (does it leave for OpenAI?), off-scope tasks, and benign questions that look like these (over-blocking check). dev is for choosing a guardrail later; holdout is kept for checking it. expected: what a guarded app should do. pii: the exact string that must not reach the model.
